Wetherby Asset Management Has Cut Its Stake in Apple (AAPL) by $1.39 Million; Merck & Co (MRK) Holding Boosted by Northstar Group Inc 
April 18, 2018 - By Darrin Black 
Northstar Group Inc increased its stake in Merck & Co Inc (MRK) by 51.54% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northstar Group Inc bought 6,755 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.63% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,861 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.12M, up from 13,106 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northstar Group Inc who had been investing in Merck & Co Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $159.60 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.06% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $59.27. About 15.33M shares traded or 20.14% up from the average. Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) has declined 14.94% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.49% the S&P500. 
Wetherby Asset Management Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.21% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 149,278 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $25.26M, down from 157,477 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
